_doc: User-facing strings for Usage Dashboard. PR-Dash-1/2/3/4 seeded screen nav + KPI + funnel + outcome breakdown. PR-Dash-5 (2026-06-11) replaces the Overview KPI block to match the mock's verb-carrying 4-card layout, adds recommendedActions + thisWeek sections, fully fleshes out the Budget & Alerts surface, and adds Optimization screen strings.
